'''Jo Wan-Kyu''' ({{langx|ko|조완규}}; 11 February 1928 – 13 July 2026) was a South Korean politician. He served as [[Minister of Education (South Korea)|Minister of Education]] from 1992 to 1993.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.koreascientists.kr/scientists/merit/merit-list/?boardId=bbs_0000000000000028&mode=view&cntId=26&category=2017&pageIdx=|title=기초생물학과 교육행정 발전에 기여한 생물학자 설랑(雪浪)|work=The Korean Academy of Science and Technology|language=Korean}}</ref> He also founded and served as the first president of the [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]] from 1994 to 1998.

Jo died on 13 July 2026, at the age of 98.<ref>{{cite news |last=Eun|first=Jeong-jin|date=13 July 2026|title='한국 생물학의 개척자' 조완규 前 서울대 총장 별세|url=https://www.hankyung.com/article/2026071326071|trans-title= |work=[[The Korea Economic Daily]]|language=Korean|location= |publisher= |access-date=13 July 2026}}</ref>
